suggested_fix: No fix required. The reorder list is selected deterministically via padata_cpu_hash(pd, seq_nr) rather than the current CPU, insertion is done under reorder->lock, and the insertion point uses list_for_each_prev with the raw list_head 'pos' so that when the loop runs to completion without breaking, list_add() inserts at the list head instead of dereferencing an out-of-bounds list_entry. The wrap-around-safe signed difference comparison and the smp_mb() pairing with padata_reorder are also correct.
